message: The other night, we had a little kitchen mishap when I got distracted while cooking. The smoke alarm went off, and my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree with everyone checking in—"Is everything okay?" and "Do we need to evacuate?" It was a funny reminder of how important it is to have a plan in place, just in case. A little laughter in a tense moment can go a long way, don’t you think?
